scope: Fresh AArch64 production build; production NI startup/selection and HTTP MTD writer compiled against modeled hardware I/O. No physical flash writes or 2.5G electrical/link acceptance in this session.

fixes.phy_failure_isolation: Quarantine only the missing/failed PHY, including Clause22 resume errors. Scan and enable healthy ports; fall back from a failed manually selected port. Preserve the normal RTL8221B initialization and 2500 Mbps path. Report ENODEV only when no PHY initializes.
fixes.physical_partition_writes: Keep NAND and RAM offsets aligned across bad blocks; synthesize FF gaps on readback. Scan the entire aligned write range before erase and refuse non-FF payload at bad physical blocks or bad-block query errors.
fixes.boot_protection: Reject generic raw writes to boot and whole-chip MTD at the server and remove boot from the generic write selector. Boot/whole-chip backups remain available. Dedicated FIP update and chunked restore retain their own validation.

regression_coverage: External PHY missing or configuration timeout: each healthy GbE port can be selected and NI startup succeeds
Healthy external PHY still selects port 4 at 2500 Mbps, including when internal PHYs fail
Each internal PHY missing/config/read/write error is isolated; no failed PHY is polled afterward
Failed fixed-port setting falls back; recovery starts without a cable and selects a healthy port on retry
No usable PHY still fails; all four 4ge ports still work in the startup model
Physical backups with first/middle/last bad blocks and nonzero-offset subranges preserve good-block data and untouched ranges
Bad-block query errors and incompatible payloads reject before any erase
Raw boot/whole-chip writes reject before erase, and backups still work
Invalid bounds/alignment reject before erase; readback corruption fails; existing dedicated FIP fault tests still pass

validation.skipped_reason: Two optional original OEM module/oracle tests require external CLI inputs; the U-Boot PHY/model tests run normally
validation.frontend: Version/commit, both boards, translation, file selection and five restore flows passed
